QuestInfo.name: A Man Atoning
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, is finally about to reveal the secret.
QuestInfo.1: #p602#, who I met at #m10005000#, told me to go find #ba man#k standing at the top of #b#m10004000##k. He clearly seems to know more than he's letting on, but for now he seems to be holding his tongue. Let's go find that #bwarrior#k at #b#m10004000##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I met #p502# at #m10004000#. I don't think I've ever seen him look so flustered before.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Talk to the warrior at the top of #m10004000#

0.0: Very well. Then I'll tell you the secret. Some years ago, the one you're seeking came to me gravely wounded, carrying blood tainted with some sinister power. He was searching for a way to purify it. But first, of course, his wounds needed tending to.
0.1: After treating his wounds, I spent years researching before I finally found a way to purify the blood, and I handed the purified blood back to him. I don't know what became of it after that, or how he used it. But that blood... hmm... never mind. More importantly, shouldn't you go find him now?

yes.0: The one you're seeking should be up at #b#m10004000#'s highest point#k right now. I trust you can guess who I'm speaking of. Go on, then.

no.0: Surely you're not making fun of me?

1.0: Ah, it's you again. I've got no business with you. Hm? That note...? ...

npc.0: The one you're seeking should be up at #b#m10004000#'s highest point#k right now. I wouldn't expect him to welcome you with open arms, though.
